title: 마법 폭발
prompt: Create a STRICT hard-pixel 16-bit videogame sprite sheet of a blue magical impact explosion, six DIFFERENT sequential frames in ONE horizontal row. Solid opaque square pixels with hard stair-step edges and deliberate dark navy outlines around the effect. No gradients of any kind, no atmospheric or diffuse light halo, no translucent haze, no bloom. Everything outside the discrete pixel shapes must be alpha0. Frame1 small navy/cyan spark,2 expanding purpleblast,3 large cyan sharpburst,4 fragmentedbluearc,5 scatteredsmallbluespecks,6 finalfewpixels. Same baseliney640. Entireartfitsinsideeach256column leaving24px padding. Do not fill background black. This is unlit sprite art, NOT an emissive render. Do not draw shadows, texts, characters, grid, floor. Each frame visibly DIFFERENT; preserve peak growth and decay.

rejectedReason: 첫 원안은 부드러운 빛 번짐이 강해 제외. 원안 편집보다 새 제한색 원안을 채택.
